description: A flower planted in the flower patch on atpota.to. One per account in the open patches; planting again replaces it. Flowers in patches that have closed stay, pressed.

patch.description: The patch the flower grows in: a to.atpota.garden.patch record in atpota.to's repo (did:plc:qntsxa2i4sb24noi45fx4np2).

plot.description: The plot in its patch, counted from the top left, row by row. If an earlier flower already has it, this one moves to the next free plot.
